text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Service `/v1/generate/stream` p95/p99 latency SLO breach detected in us-west-2. Rolling p99 spike -> 2.8s (normally ~0.45s). Streaming stalls observed (connections hanging) beginning at ~2026-03-15T02:10:00Z. Autoscale not triggering; error-rate stable. Deploy ID: deploy-20260315-22. Suspected change: recent quantization calibration rollout (int8/fp8 mixes). Paging on-call.

oncall_anna: ACK — I'm on it, paging @sam-eng and @maria-sre. Opening bridge. Anyone seeing customer impact?

sam-eng: seeing the same. Correlates with a calib job that rolled ~02:08Z: `calib-job/2026-03-15T02:06Z` applied to model variant `rw-llama-7b-int8-calib-v3`. Kernel timings show huge dequant/reshape cost on long sequences.

maria-sre: metrics: KV cache miss rate up ~4x, throughput per-gpu down ~30%. p95 up to 1.2s, p99 up to 2.8s. Streaming stall traces show loop waiting on dequant path. Logs:
```
[stream-worker-12] dequant_op latency 1.9s cnt=124
[stream-worker-12] kv_cache_miss=true session_id=.. token_idx=512
```

lee-devex: support tickets: customer-ACME (ent) reported streaming timeouts and partial rewrites at 02:15Z. They hit our SLO. Support ticket #INC-4729. @support-jordan can you confirm?

support-jordan: yep, confirmed. Customer-facing timeout ~15s then socket close. I've updated ticket and posted interim note: "we're investigating latency and have a mitigation in progress." They requested ETA for fix.

pg-manager: how many customers impacted and SLA exposure? Need immediate estimate to escalate to sales if >5 customers.

maria-sre: quick estimate from traffic logs: ~3% of streaming sessions in us-west-2 had stalls >5s between 02:10-02:25Z. Roughly 6 paying customers saw degraded UX; two reported directly.

oncall_anna: propose immediate mitigation: 1) pause calib rollout (stop further calibs), 2) rollback model variant for streaming routes to `rw-llama-7b-fp16-stable`, 3) add routing rule to prefer legacy variant for sessions >256 tokens. Who can run rollback?

sam-eng: I can do rollback. Suggest also disabling the int8 dequant fastpath in runtime as a hotpatch while we diagnose. That should reduce tail latency but cost more tokens.

lee-devex: routing rule snippet (for ops-runbook):
```
route update /v1/generate/stream --if payload.len>256 --prefer-model rw-llama-7b-fp16-stable --reason "emergency tail mitigation"
```

oncall_anna: executing rollback now.

ops-bot: `deploy-rollback deploy-20260315-22 -> deploy-20260314-89` initiated by oncall_anna. Job queued.

sam-eng: also toggled runtime flag: `--disable-dequant-fastpath=true` on streaming fleet in us-west-2 (canary 10% then 100%). Monitoring.

incident-bot: UPDATE: rollback job started at 02:21Z; routing rule applied (canary 20% traffic -> legacy fp16), runtime flag canary at 10%.

maria-sre: early telemetry: p99 for canary nodes down to ~0.9s. Overall p99 across region now 1.6s and trending down. KV cache miss rate decreasing on canary.

oncall_anna: pushing the routing rule to 100% for streaming endpoints in us-west-2 to minimize customer impact.

ops-bot: routing change applied to 100% for `/v1/generate/stream` in us-west-2. Rollback job completed. Canary runtime flag rolled to 100%.

incident-bot: UPDATE @channel: p95 back to 0.5s, p99 stabilizing at 0.7-0.9s. Streaming stall reports dropping. Continuing to monitor for 30m.

support-jordan: updated ACME with ETA and that we rolled back calibration; customer appreciated prompt update and will monitor on their side. Ticket #INC-4729 updated.

pg-manager: thanks — please keep a tally of affected customers for postmortem so we can coordinate credits if needed.

sam-eng: short dump from post-rollback diagnostic: the int8 calibration had introduced a pathological quantization pattern for long kv-cache sessions (tokens >384) causing extra dequant passes for certain attention blocks. Reproducer script attached to internal bug (link in thread). Plan: stronger pre-rollout telemetry gating + synthetic long-context tests.

maria-sre: action items (captured):
- revert calib rollout immediately (done)
- add gating: require p99 delta <20% on long-context synthetic tests before rollout
- add runtime feature-flag to disable dequant fastpath per-model
- postmortem and customer impact report

lee-devex: I'll prep a developer note with code for the routing rule and a snippet for using `--disable-dequant-fastpath` in local testing.

oncall_anna: marking incident as mitigated at 02:34Z. We'll keep monitoring until 03:04Z. I'll open a postmortem doc and assign owners: sam-eng (root cause + fix), maria-sre (rollout gating + playbook), lee-devex (dev docs), support-jordan (customer comms), pg-manager (business impact).

incident-bot: INCIDENT MITIGATED: p99/p95 within SLOs in us-west-2. Incident duration ~24 minutes. Tags: quantization, calibration, tail-latency, rollback.

support-jordan: will follow up with ACME and the two other customers with a short summary. :thumbsup:

pg-manager: schedule a 1-hour RCA meeting tomorrow. Need a draft customer note by EOD.

oncall_anna: copying final notes into the postmortem ticket. Closing thread for now; will re-open if regressions observed. Thanks all for quick responses. :white_check_mark:
